preconditions.description: The length of the array a must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i] <= i for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element a[i] must be a non-negative integer and less than or equal to its index i.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] <= a[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: The array a must be non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid else True
postconditions.description: If no valid array b exists, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b[i] <= 1000000 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element b[i] must be a non-negative integer and less than or equal to 1000000.

postconditions.expression: all(MEX(b[:i+1]) == a[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each i, the MEX of the first i+1 elements of b must equal a[i].
